description: Fixed support-stake obstacles in ROBOT frame for deterministic blade/arm clearance (independent of the noisy point cloud). Each stake is a vertical cylinder.
source: 2026-06-02: stake_py_main (+y/left) and stake_ny (-y/right, near) are TOUCH-MEASURED (FK + 157mm tip), modeled as tilted segments (base/top), radius 0.008. stake_ny_far is still a CLOUD DRAFT (unmeasured) - touch-measure before cutting near it. Both-sides touches over-read (~5cm) because they catch the T-clips, so each rod uses the single approach-facing side + 0.008 buffer.

stakes.name: stake_py_main
stakes.confidence: touch-measured 3pts 2026-06-02 (FK + 157mm tip); cloud estimate [0.664,0.21] was ~4.6cm off in y. Stake leans ~4cm in y over its height.

stakes.name: stake_ny
stakes.confidence: touch-measured 2026-06-02 (approach-facing +y side low_a/high_a; the far/-y touches caught the T-clip ~5cm off so used the near face + 0.008 buffer). Right rod near the -y petioles; leans +x/-y rising; spans z 0.85-1.30 to cover the lower petioles (~0.88).
